spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (रदति)
1 To divide, to split, to tear or break.
2 To dig, to delve, to root.

m. (-दः)
1 A tooth.
2 Splitting, tearing, dividing.
E.
रद to divide, &c., aff. अच्.

m. (-दः)
A lip.
E.
रद a tooth, and छद covering.

m. (-नः)
A tooth.
n. (-नं)
Tearing, rending.
E.
रद to divide, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-दः)
A lip.
E.
रदन a tooth, and छद covering.

m. (-दी)
An elephant.
E.
रद a tooth, a tusk, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Hurt, injured.
E.
रध to hurt, क्त aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Cooked, dressed.
2 Perfected, as a religious vow; observed, as a fast, &c.
3 Perfect, in mysterious or magical power, adept, initiated.
4 Perfect in general, accomplished; finished, complete, mature, &c.
E.
राध to accomplish or be accomplished, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-द्धा-द्धी-द्धृ)
Injurious, hurtful, who or what hurts.
E.
रध to hurt, तृच् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
Demonstrated truth, proved and established fact or conclusion.
E.
राद्ध established, अन्त end, result.
